messages:
emily: quick ask — need a merge to unblock a production rollback. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4321

rahul: paste the migration diff and any backfill steps? will skim before approval

emily: short summary: change a column from nullable -> NOT NULL, plus a small backfill script. staging run < 1 min, smoke tests passed locally. attaching logs to PR.

emily: CODEOWNERS shows:
```
src/featurestore/* @data-platform/team
infra/featurestore/* @eng-infra/team
```

marcus: data-platform lead (maria) is listed as owner. but she's on rotation tonight and CODEOWNERS has no explicit backup. who can proxy in emergencies?

tess: convention: eng-platform can sign off on urgent hotfixes if the owning team is on-call but unresponsive — but we require a short audit note in the PR and a direct ack from the on-call if possible.

emily: drafting audit note: reason: customer-facing rollback; risk: schema alignment only; mitigations: staging run + dry-run logs attached; monitoring plan post-merge.

ops-bot: on-call lookup: @maria on-call for data-platform until 2026-03-18 08:00 UTC. pagerduty: on-call.

marcus: pinged maria directly: @maria can you quick ack or nominate a proxy? if no reply in 10m someone from eng-platform can approve per tess' guidance.

maria: (7m) saw this — tying up with an incident but glanced at the migration. I'm fine with marcus approving as proxy. ensure the backfill uses the transactional path and keep the safety flag enabled until green monitoring.

marcus: thanks. emily, once you add the audit note and re-run staging, i'll approve and merge. leave a short post-merge playbook snippet in the PR.

emily: running staging again and adding the audit note now.

emily: staging run OK, uploaded logs and dry-run output to the PR.

amarcus (typo corrected): approving now and will merge. tagging @eng-sre for a quick post-merge smoke check.

tess: :thumbsup: small follow-up: let's add a CODEOWNERS fallback for src/featurestore/* so there's a documented secondary approver for next time.

emily: agree — i'll open a tiny PR to add an `@eng-platform/backup-approvers` entry after this goes through.

ops-bot: merge status: PR #4321 merged by marcus at 2765432160. CI: all checks passed. deployment to prod initiated.

emily: kicking off deploy monitor now, will post any anomalies. thanks everyone!
